findings.transcript_evidence: Very important: if you get numbness around your bottom or genitals, difficulty passing urine, loss of control of your bladder or bowels, or weakness in both legs, go to A&E straight away. That could be a rare emergency called cauda equina syndrome. I'll give you a card with these symptoms on.
findings.rationale: The note omits the critical safety netting advice regarding cauda equina syndrome symptoms, which is a high-risk emergency.
